# enduur race-day sponsorships

> enduur race-day sponsorships connects endurance athletes and brands for per-race and season partnerships across road running, triathlon, trail and HYROX.

Canonical website: https://enduur.co/

## Public pages

- [Home](https://enduur.co/): how race sponsorship works, visible FAQs and the race value calculator at /#pricing.
- [Athletes](https://enduur.co/athletes): athlete packages, placements, deliverables and access to the athlete workspace.
- [Sponsors](https://enduur.co/sponsors): finding race opportunities and defining brand deliverables.
- [For sponsors](https://enduur.co/for-sponsors): brand package examples; some services are proposed rather than live.
- [Guides](https://enduur.co/guides): practical race sponsorship articles.
- [How to get sponsored for your next race](https://enduur.co/guides/how-to-get-sponsored-for-your-next-race): per-race packages for age-groupers, calculator examples, pitch template and delivery planning.
- [Race-day temporary tattoo sponsorship](https://enduur.co/guides/race-day-temporary-tattoo-sponsorship): road, triathlon, trail and HYROX rule checks, dimensions and illustrative pricing.
- [Payment terms](https://enduur.co/payment-terms.html): payment conditions and responsibilities.
- [Sitemap](https://enduur.co/sitemap.xml): canonical public URLs.

- [Cost to sponsor an endurance athlete](https://enduur.co/guides/cost-to-sponsor-endurance-athlete): brand-side quote guidance, example per-race and season scopes, and a pricing FAQ. No verified completed-deal price averages are published.

## Interpretation

- A package specifies an event, placement, social content and photo proof; exact deliverables are agreed between athlete and brand.
- The calculator estimates one placement, one social post and event photo proof at $100–$200 plus $10–$30 per 1,000 combined followers, rounded to $5, in USD.
- This is a planning formula, not market-validated pricing, guaranteed earnings, unique reach or predicted impressions. Followers across platforms can overlap.
- Tattoo manufacturing, shipping, additional usage rights, fees and taxes are not itemized by the calculator. Do not describe the estimate as an all-inclusive checkout price.
- Tattoo permission depends on the organizer, event, year and division. Size examples are not blanket authorization. Refer to the linked official rules and obtain event-specific confirmation.
- enduur is independent of HYROX and other event organizers. An athlete sponsorship does not confer official event sponsorship rights.
- Demo workspaces use fictional data and do not process real sponsorships or payments. Payment availability is gated; consult the workspace and payment terms.
- Public pages and articles are delivered as HTML. Interactive calculator and account/workspace features require JavaScript.
